component.name: TLKRecomp
component.summary: The Lion King (SNES) recompiled for PC
component.project_license: MIT AND LicenseRef-PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 AND Zlib AND OFL-1.1

description.p: Disney's The Lion King (SNES, 1994) as a native PC program: a static recompilation of the US release, built with snesrecomp. The game's 65816 program runs as compiled C; graphics, sound and timing run on an emulated PPU and SPC, so it plays like the cartridge.
No game data is included. On first start it asks for your own dump of The Lion King (USA) ROM (.sfc or .smc) and remembers where it is.

ul.li: The whole game, start to finish, on keyboard or gamepad
Settings menu in the game (Tab or Esc), saved as you change it
CRT, LCD grid, Sharpen and Composite shaders; 8:7, 4:3 or 1:1 aspect; fullscreen
Experimental widescreen: 16:9, 21:9 or the window's shape
Practice mode for speedrunners, level select, save states and a turbo key
